name: core-reactions
description: Reactions, the core's rules that move Workflow statuses after a change commits: a task that starts moves its project to active, a project whose tasks are all finished is done, as the runner's principal, through Workflow's transition, whose events record the cause. allTerminal and anyTerminal read the outcomes of the linking instances' terminal states, so a run completes when its steps all pass and fails when one fails, in whatever order the events and the rules come. A rule leaves a target it cannot move; a misconfigured one halts its subscription.
